Die ROMEO-Mission zielt darauf ab, neue Technologien in niedrigen und mittleren Erdumlaufbahnen zu demonstrieren, Strahlungsanalysen durchzuführen und das Albedo der Erde zu beobachten. SUSs sind wichtige Komponente des Lageregelungssystems für Satelliten. Diese können den Winkel im Weltraum relativ zur Sonne mit einer Genauigkeit von wenigen Grad messen. SUS sind unverzichtbar für den kritischen Sicherheitsmodus des Satelliten, in dem eine stromsparende Ausrichtung zur Sonne notwendig ist. normalized.description: Exploitation Platforms are a central element of ESA's Earth Observation (EO) Innovation Europe concept, which aims at the integration of EO data and information for a much broader use, for scientific, social and economic purposes, as well as for the generation of new commercial applications and services. The EO Network of Resources (NoR) initiative promotes the use of European resource and platform services to facilitate a simplified and efficient exploitation of EO data in cloud environments. The initiative incentivizes providers to contribute to a common framework harmonising the access to their services and helping the user to work with the data. RHEA has been awarded the EO Digital Platform – EO Network Of Resources 2023-2028 contract (AO/1-11738/23/I-EF), the follow-up of the project Procurement of Earth Observation Exploitation Platform Network Resource Services (ITT AO/1-9217/18/I-LG) finished in November 2023. The NoR portal (https://nor-discover.org) lists in an online directory all the onboarded providers together with their NoR service portfolio. ESA can sponsor or co-fund scientists and value adding users for eligible research, development and pre-commercial projects. The portal also provides users with links to each providers helpdesk and website. This intended tender is for the selection of Resource Tier and Platform Tier providers using cloud services with collocated Sentinel and non-Sentinel data. Resource Tier and Platform Tier providers wishing to contribute to the NoR service directory are invited to provide a proposal.
